Alex R.: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need clear owners + short timelines for the remediation items. recurring pattern: DB connection spikes at midnight, triage steps unclear, and escalation path isn't explicit. can people volunteer?

Maya C.: I can own the runbook edits for triage steps and commands. will add exact queries and `kubectl` snippets. timeline: aim to PR in 10 business days. @Alex R. do you want me to include rollback notes?

Zach H.: +1 from infra. i'll add a quick check script and health endpoint for the DB connection pool so oncall can run a single command. plan: `scripts/check-connections.sh` and a short `curl` health. will PR automation to run nightly smoke.

Emily S.: sounds good. i'll own the escalation lane doc — map thresholds to pager severity and contact rotation. propose: add explicit thresholds (e.g., connections > 80% for 5m => page L2, 95% for 2m => page L1). can we keep the thresholds in the runbook as code constants? easier to sync with automation.

Samir P.: noting recurring cause: bulk nightly jobs that stomp connections. i can own remediation for job submission (circuit-breaker + staggered backoff). also propose adding a quick triage command set in the runbook:
```
# check active DB connections
psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active';"
# tail app logs for errors
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=worker --since=5m | grep -i connection
# restart worker job queue if stuck (safe restart)
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/worker --timeout=2m
```

incident-bot: New postmortem actions created: PM-4872, PM-4873, PM-4874. See https://redwood.infra/postmortems/PM-4872 for full action tracker.

Alex R.: good — want owners, deliverables, and due dates in the tracker by EOD tomorrow. current volunteers: Maya (runbook triage + commands) -> due 2024-06-07, Zach (check script + automation) -> due 2024-06-14, Emily (escalation lane doc + thresholds) -> due 2024-06-10, Samir (job submission remediation) -> due 2024-06-21. can everyone confirm?

Maya C.: confirmed. will include rollback/mitigation steps and a short test plan.

Zach H.: confirmed. i'll add unit test for the script and a small runner in CI.

Emily S.: confirmed. i'll coordinate a 30m oncall walk-through after PR merges.

Samir P.: confirmed. will open design doc today and link to the action tracker.

Alex R.: great, thanks all. i'll schedule weekly 15m syncs until all items are closed. please tag PM-4872/3/4 in PRs. :thumbsup:
